observations: Routing gap found while implementing: edge conditions resolve preferred_label from outcome.preferred_label only (fabro-workflow condition.rs resolve_key), so a strictly-scoped context_updates-only merge would have left the re-pointed planner always falling through to the unconditional `Seed claimed` edge — Tracker empty/Blocked/Verification-only/Planner failed could never route. Applying routing fields for file-schema payloads that contain a routing status field (contains_routing_field — which itself counts context_updates) closes it; this also means the pre-hotfix #233 window had the same silent misroute potential, not just the blind-implementer symptom.

contains_routing_field treats context_updates as a routing field, so the new application guard fires for any payload that has context_updates even without preferred_next_label/outcome — intentional (mirrors extract_status_fields) but worth knowing when authoring future file schemas.
